description: This file contains integration tests for loan accrual transaction reversals within the Apache Fineract project. It extends a base loan integration test class and includes test methods for verifying accrual and reversal logic for different loan scenarios, such as multiple disbursements and interest recalculations.

classes.name: LoanAccrualTransactionReversalTest
classes.description: JUnit integration test class for verifying loan accrual transaction reversals and related accrual behavior in Apache Fineract.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST Assured, request/response specifications, and helper objects before each test.

methods.name: testNoAccrualTransactionReversalForMultipleDisbursementWithChargeForLoanAccountWithNoInterestBearingSchedulePeriodicAccrual
methods.description: Tests that no accrual transaction is reversed in a scenario with multiple disbursements and charges, with no interest-bearing schedule.

methods.name: testLastAccrualTransactionReversalRecalculationForLoanAccountWithInterestBearingScheduleWithDecliningBalance
methods.description: Tests the behavior of last accrual transaction reversal and recalculation for interest-bearing loans with declining balance interest calculation.

methods.name: createLoanAccountWithInterestRecalculation
methods.description: Creates a loan account with interest recalculation settings, using specified client and product IDs.

methods.name: createLoanProductWithInterestRecalculation
methods.description: Builds an interest recalculating loan product with specified parameters.

methods.name: createLoanProductWithMultipleDisbursement
methods.description: Creates a loan product configured for multiple disbursements.

methods.name: createLoanAccount
methods.description: Builds and approves a basic loan account for a given client and product.

methods.name: checkAccrualTransaction
methods.description: Verifies that an accrual transaction exists for a specific date with expected interest, fee, and penalty portions.
